description:
In the Northwind Traders business, you need to set up a new inventory location for a showroom and transfer stock to it. 

First, enable the 'Inventory Locations' and 'Inventory Transfers' modules using the Customize button (these are currently hidden). 

Next, create a new Inventory Location named 'Showroom'. 

Finally, create a new Inventory Transfer to move 40 units of 'Chai' from the default location to the 'Showroom'. Set the date to '2026-05-01' and description to 'Initial stock for showroom'.
